title: ComCare Support for Those Who Do Not Stay in Public Rental Housing and Extension of ComLink+ To Them
what_it_is: ComCare Support for Those Who Do Not Stay in Public Rental Housing and Extension of ComLink+ To Them

sections.label: ComLink+ for non-rental families
sections.summary: MSF will offer ComLink+ to lower-income families not in public rental housing who are eligible for KidSTART or UPLIFT Community Network, reaching 3,000 households over three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In addition to families with children residing in public rental housing, the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) will also offer ComLink+ to lower-income families that are not residing in public rental housing but who are eligible for KidSTART or the UPLIFT Community Network.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: We aim to reach 3,000 such households over the next three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Like other ComLink+ families, these families can be offered the ComLink+ Progress Packages if they take active steps towards securing a better future for themselves.

sections.label: Trial before further expansion
sections.summary: ComLink+ progress packages will be trialled with these 3,000 families over three years, and further expansion will be considered only if the packages prove successful.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Only then would we consider if ComLink+ should be expanded further to cover other groups of lower-income families.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: As I mentioned, there are about 3,000 households who are not in rental flat housing but qualify for KidSTART or UPLIFT Community Network.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: So, in the next phase of ComLink+ in the next three years, where we are trialling our ComLink+ progress packages, we will be reaching out to these 3,000 families.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: And if these ComLink+ progress packages prove indeed successful, we will then consider reaching out to more lower-income families beyond these 3,000.
